evidence.quote: The program is offered entirely in English.

notes: The task named the programme "Economic and Social Sciences" but the two supplied Bocconi pages with that title are for the Master of Science programme (https://www.unibocconi.it/en/programs/bachelor-science/economic-and-social-sciences — the URL sits under a Bachelor of Science path but the page content is the MSc in Economic and Social Sciences: it links to "Study Abroad Programs" and "Our Research Network" and is listed in the Master of Science menu of the navigation). No evidence of a dedicated Bachelor-level programme page for "Economic and Social Sciences" is present among the supplied pages. The durationYears ("3 yrs") and teachingLanguages ("offered entirely in English") facts are quoted from the supplied page of that URL and may refer to the MSc listing rather than a BSc; the auditor should verify the programme identity and level. Tuition: the only one-figure-per-year amount in the supplied pages is the general Bocconi first-year undergraduate investment of 17.000 euro a year; it is for "corsi di laurea triennale" in a.a. 2026-2027 generally and is not explicitly stated as the fee for a non-EU student living abroad, so it may not apply to this applicant. No intakes, application channel (Universitaly or a Bocconi application portal), or document list for this programme are stated in the supplied pages.
